ns2:section.sectionText: This year’s Sustainable Planning Workshop focuses on parks as infrastructure for creating healthy and resilient communities. Students will collaborate to build essential planning skills through real world applications of park planning and create professional products for a local park district. Students will also employ tools including ArcGIS and drone photography, refine oral and written communication skills, generate meaningful community engagement strategies, and design multi benefit solutions for environmental planning issues. (Juniors restricted from registering unless approval given by BAUSP Director Alice Novak.)
